source.name: Philadelphia Inquirer, 'Union and Bimbo Bakeries renew jersey sponsorship through 2028'
source.quote: A relationship that started in 2011 will continue through 2028.

note: Fourth term (five further seasons) of a partnership running since 2011; Bimbo on primary kits, Thomas' (Bimbo Bakeries USA) on secondary kits. The club called the renewal 'multimillion-dollar' with no figure disclosed; the same report says earlier terms paid about $3m/season (2011-14) and $2.3m/season (2015-19).
